(a) Awaiting new SBTi standards, which may lead to adjusting current targets.
(b) Net Zero ambition is explained in section 4.3.1 Climate change.
(c) Danone’s journey to achieve and maintain deforestation and conversion-free status on these direct key commodities (palm oil, soybeans, paper and board, cocoa)
means at least a 97% verified deforestation- and conversion-free rate, due to the verification process and supply chain constraints. More information on these
processes is available in section 4.3.5 Resource use and circular economy (ESRS E5).
(d) Recover means recycle or valorize through energy recovery the equivalent amount by weight of plastic packaging put on the market.
